excerpt.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
excerpt.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

sections.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

texts.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]被炸弹轰炸得坑坑洼洼，在大约两千年前，这里似乎曾被某群人当做靶场。残余能源示数表明，那伙人测试的武器也是千奇百怪，其中包括亚空间炸弹和某种奇点生成器。我们的科学家很想研究一下残余的能源回波。
texts.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is pockmarked with craters from weapon blasts, and appears to have been used as a target range by someone roughly two millennia ago. Residual energy readings suggest they tested increasingly exotic weaponry, including subspace bombs and some kind of singularity generator. Our scientists would be interested in studying the unusual energy echoes that remain.

texts.zh: 这颗独特的小行星是在太阳系外的来客。之前，它似乎在穿越星际空间时遭受到了某种外星辐射的洗礼，随后进入了[From.GetStarName]星系。这种辐射的来源目前已不得而知，但通过研究小行星的能源辐射，[Root.GetName]得到了许多物理数据。
texts.en: This particular asteroid is an extrasolar capture, and appears to have been washed by some kind of exotic radiation as it plummeted through interstellar space before finally settling in the [From.GetStarName] system. The original source of this radiation remains unknown, but the [Root.GetName] has been able to pick up a wealth of physics data by studying the asteroid's energy emissions.
